brand.description: The brand name. Inferred from the site when empty. Keywords that name the brand are left out.

count.description: How many keywords to suggest, at most 50, and never more than the room left in the 200-keyword list.

description.description: What the product does and who it is for. Inferred from the site when empty.

domain.description: The project's site, for example posthog.com. The model reads it with web search when the project's prompts and searches are not enough.
